POC technical plan (agreed high-level):
- Environment: Dedicated pool in customer VPC (us-east primary). Small canary capacity in us-east with 2 nodes reserved.
- Canary rollout: start with 5% of production traffic redirected to Dedicated pool for 48h; expand to 25% for next 72h if metrics OK; full cutover only after 7 days of steady metrics.
- Routing + model variants: requests route by policy — prefer 'quant8' (8-bit quantized) model variant for cost-sensitive paths (embeddings + reranking), fallback to 'fp16' model variant for high-quality generation.
- Region failover: primary us-east -> secondary us-west -> tertiary eu-west. Failover policy: automatic on healthcheck failures or when 95th latency > 200ms for 10m window.
- Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% (5m), quality regression detected by evaluation set (auto-eval delta > 3% on precision@K), or sustained latency SLO breach (95th > 250ms for 15m).
